newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close higher on strong retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close higher on strong retail buying.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher as blue-chip shares gained amid enthusiastic retail buying.

The Dhaka Stocks Exchange (DSE) all-share price index rose 23.45 points, or 1.50 percent, to 1578.06 on volume of 198.27 million taka. Of the 111 issues traded, 53 ended up, 54 closed down and four were unchanged.
Beximco Pharmaceuticals gained 21.05 taka to 147.60, Bata Shoe Company was up 28.69 to 204.71 and leasing IDLC lost 89.48 to 4,393.85.
